title: Supplier approval records
frame: A nonprofit requires documented approval before staff place supplier orders above an internal spending threshold. A quarterly review found that 14 of 90 sampled orders lack an approval attachment in the purchasing system. Approvals may also be recorded in meeting minutes or delegated-authority forms. The operations lead must prepare a defensible account of what happened and decide which records or process changes to pursue before the board review in three weeks. The internal rule is given; no legal conclusion is requested.
